name: Verdant Sigil
summary: In Shadowglen, Conservator Ilthalaine gives young night elf druids the Verdant Sigil as a summons to begin training.

sections.title: A Summons to the Path
sections.body: Young night elves in Shadowglen who feel the call of the wild receive the Verdant Sigil from Conservator Ilthalaine. A messenger brings it from Mardant Strongoak, the druid trainer, and it directs novices to climb into Aldrassil's boughs. The token invites them to leave basic chores behind and begin serious study of communion with nature spirits and the mysteries of the Emerald Dream.

sections.title: The First Step Into the Dream
sections.body: Presenting the Verdant Sigil to Mardant Strongoak begins a young druid's lifelong craft. Novices are not yet ready to walk the sleeping trance of the Emerald Dream, but the token marks the start of their mentorship. Under Mardant's instruction, they learn to read the wilderness's whispers and practice early shapeshifting and healing arts in service of Teldrassil.

faq.q: What is the purpose of the Verdant Sigil?
aliases: why do i have verdant sigil
faq.answer: The Verdant Sigil summons novice night elf druids in Shadowglen to seek out Mardant Strongoak in Aldrassil and begin formal training.

faq.q: Who hands out the Verdant Sigil?
aliases: where do i get verdant sigil
faq.answer: Conservator Ilthalaine gives budding druids the Verdant Sigil in Shadowglen, carrying a message from Mardant Strongoak.

faq.q: Where do I take the sigil once I receive it?
aliases: where do i bring verdant sigil
faq.answer: You bring the Verdant Sigil to Mardant Strongoak, the druid trainer in Aldrassil's central chambers at the heart of Shadowglen.

faq.q: What happens after presenting the sigil to Mardant Strongoak?
aliases: what does mardant do with sigil
faq.answer: Mardant accepts the Verdant Sigil and welcomes you as his student. He guides you in communion with nature and prepares you for the mysteries of the Emerald Dream as your strength grows.

angles.text: As a young night elf druid, receiving the Verdant Sigil marks your first rite of passage from basic forest tending to disciplined Cenarion teaching.
Under Aldrassil's canopy, the sigil reflects the kaldorei tradition of attuning your spirit to the natural world and Teldrassil's guardians.
